D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonCartesianChain.cartesian_chain
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem cartesian_chain (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : realOperator m (cartesian0 m) = 0 ∧ realOperator m (cartesian1 m) = cartesian0 m

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonCartesianChain.unbounded_linear_drift
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem unbounded_linear_drift (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => cartesian1 m + τ • cartesian0 m) (realOperator m (cartesian1 m + t • cartesian0 m)) t) ∧ ¬ Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range (fun t : ℝ => cartesian1 m + t • cartesian0 m))
